caption: The drawing features a centrally positioned ornamental object outlined in black ink against a plain, light beige background. The object has a symmetrical design with a stylized, fan-shaped upper portion adorned with decorative curves and cut-outs, resembling a shell or leaf. Below the top, two parallel, vertical elements curve outward and downward, forming elongated S-shaped lines that merge into an elaborate scrollwork pattern at the bottom. In the center of the composition is a vertical bar featuring a rounded, notched middle section, ending in a pointed tip. The entire decorative piece is rendered with consistent line thickness, and the only text present is the name "Julius Bellamy" handwritten in small script at the lower left corner. There are no colors other than the black ink of the drawing lines and the off-white color of the paper.
title: Door Knocker
